jobs.title: Director of IT Systems and Cybersecurity
jobs.description:
Vi is seeking a Director of IT Systems and Cybersecurity to provide strategic leadership and operational oversight across our cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity program, enterprise technology environment, and on-premise physical systems.

Reporting to the Vice President of IT and Chief Information Security Officer, this highly visible leadership role will influence technology direction across the organization while ensuring the security, reliability, and operational integrity of systems supporting our corporate office and communities.

The Director will serve as the organization’s subject matter expert across three critical areas:

* Microsoft Azure, including Azure Virtual Machines, Entra ID, and cloud storage
* The Microsoft cybersecurity stack and third-party security tools, including Managed Detection and Response and external Security Operations Center services
* On-premise physical systems, including life safety, audiovisual, digital communications, building access and management, food and beverage, and security systems

This role is ideal for a strategic technology leader who can develop long-term roadmaps while remaining engaged in the operational details needed to protect the organization, support business continuity, and deliver reliable technology solutions across a complex, multi-site environment.

**Why Join Vi?**

Vi is proud to be recognized as a Great Place to Work and one of Glassdoor's 100 Best Companies to Work For.

At Vi, you’ll have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced leaders, contribute to meaningful work, and help shape experiences that positively impact the lives of older adults and their families.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive pay which may include eligibility for discretionary bonus compensation subject to individual, department and company performance and the terms of the applicable bonus plan.
* Comprehensive benefits package
* Generous Paid Time Off beginning on day one
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid maternity and paternity leave
* Award-winning training and professional development
* Tuition reimbursement
* Luxury work environment
* Meaningful, mission-driven work

A summary of our employee Benefits may be found by clicking here.

**This is an on-site role based in our Chicago corporate office at 233 S. Wacker Drive on the 84th floor. The position requires working in the office five days per week.**

**Leadership and Strategy:**

* In conjunction with the VP of IT and CISO, provides strategic direction for IT systems, cybersecurity, and infrastructure initiatives.
* Responsible for directly supervising the IT Cybersecurity Analyst. Responsibilities include hiring, training and development, counseling, performance evaluation, functional development and disciplinary action.
* Oversees vendor management, contract renewals, and service agreements for all technology areas within the role’s scope, including Azure, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and on-premise physical systems. Partners with Procurement, Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders to support negotiations, monitor vendor performance, and ensure services align with business, security, compliance, and budget requirements.
* Develops and maintains technology roadmaps for all areas within the role’s scope, including Microsoft Azure, cybersecurity tools, enterprise infrastructure, and on-premise physical systems.
* Establishes and maintains policies, procedures, standards, and documentation related to cybersecurity, IT systems, cloud infrastructure, and physical technology systems.
* Works closely with onsite staff SMEs to manage and provide planning and project management oversight for MACs of these systems.

**Microsoft Azure:**

* Oversees the Microsoft Azure environment.
* Performs needed MACs (Moves, Adds, Changes) for all Azure-related infrastructure.
* Oversees technical design, planning, implementation, and support for Azure virtual infrastructure supporting enterprise applications, including Azure Virtual Machines, Entra ID, and cloud storage.

**Cybersecurity Operations:**

* Serves as Incident Response Manager for all cybersecurity events, including incident response planning and execution.
* Directs the Company’s security program, including monitoring the environment and ensuring regular patching and updating of all digital systems and equipment.
* Manages and optimizes the Company’s security technology stack, including: Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) platform for log collection, correlation, and analysis; Managed Detection and Response (MDR) platform; and Phishing simulation and security awareness training programs
* Oversees the Microsoft cybersecurity stack and related third party cybersecurity tools.
* Oversees Azure security operations including Entra ID management and cloud security controls
* Manages relationship with external SOC and ensures compliance with agreed-upon SLAs for threat detection and remediation.
* Develops and maintains security metrics and reporting from these platforms to track security posture and team performance.

**On-Premise Physical Systems:**

* Oversees all on-premise physical systems at all locations needed for business operations, including Life Safety (Nurse Call, Lifeline, Wander management, etc.), Audio/Video, Digital Communications, Building Access Management, Building Systems Management, F&B Systems, and Security Systems. Works closely with risk and compliance teams to ensure all systems are in compliance with regulatory requirements.

**Budget and Financial Oversight:**

* Recommends and supports budgets for areas of responsibility, including Azure services, cybersecurity tools, infrastructure systems, physical technology systems, vendors, and related projects. Responsible for procurement and oversight of external resources required to assist with assigned projects.

**Travel:**

* This position requires 25% travel.

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science is required. Master’s degree preferred.

**Company Overview**
  
  
Performance Contracting Group is a national employee-owned specialty contractor that offers quality services and products to the commercial, industrial, and non-residential construction markets. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and advancing employees from a diversity of backgrounds and experiences, as well as supporting a culture of safety and inclusiveness that allows you to contribute to your fullest potential. We place high value on training and professional development, encouraging you to broaden and strengthen your unique skill sets so you can fully realize your potential.

The Director, IT Engineering provides enterprise leadership for the software, data, integration, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 capabilities that enable PCG’s business operations. The role is accountable for designing, building, integrating, modernizing, and sustaining secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. This leader establishes disciplined engineering practices, clear ownership, and outcome-based roadmaps that accelerate business value while improving quality, maintainability and cost effectiveness.

**Leadership Mandate**

Build an integrated enterprise engineering capability with persistent ownership of custom software, business applications, enterprise data pipelines and products, APIs and integrations, and the Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform. Set direction, establish operating expectations, and ensure internal teams and partners are accountable for measurable business outcomes, technical quality, secure delivery, operational readiness, and sustainable lifecycle management.

**Strategic Outcomes**
======================

* Faster delivery of business capabilities through modern software engineering, reusable components, automation, and clear alignment to enterprise priorities.
* Clear ownership and outcome-based roadmaps for custom software, Microsoft Dynamics 365, enterprise data products, APIs, and integrations.
* Reliable, secure, and maintainable applications supported by consistent architecture, development, testing, release, monitoring, and support practices.
* Trusted, governed, and reusable enterprise data that enables reporting, analytics, automation, AI, and better operational decisions.
* A simplified integration environment that reduces point-to-point interfaces, improves data flow, and connects Dynamics 365 with core enterprise and field systems.
* A high-performing engineering organization with strong technical leadership, talent development, financial discipline, and accountability for business outcomes.

**Key Accountabilities**
========================

* Engineering Strategy & Operating Model: Publish and maintain a rolling 18–24-month roadmap for software, data, integration, and Dynamics 365 capabilities; review priorities, capacity, dependencies, risks, and expected business outcomes with technology and business leaders at least quarterly.
* Software Engineering: Ensure 100% of actively developed applications have an accountable owner, documented architecture, product backlog, support model, security classification, lifecycle status, and measurable service objectives. Establish automated build, test, security, and deployment controls for all material production releases.
* Microsoft Dynamics 365 Engineering: Own the platform roadmap, solution architecture, configuration, extensions, Power Platform components, security roles, integrations, data, release calendar, and partner delivery. Review customizations quarterly and require documented business justification, ownership, testing, and lifecycle plans for all approved extensions.
* Data Engineering: Assign accountable owners and service measures to all critical data products and pipelines. Monitor data quality, freshness, availability, lineage, security, and failed processing daily; maintain remediation plans for measures below target.

* Engineering Quality & Operations: Set and report monthly measures for delivery lead time, deployment frequency, failed changes, production defects, availability, incident recovery, automated test coverage, vulnerabilities, and recurring incidents. Require documented production-readiness approval before release.
* Architecture, Security & Governance Partnership: Ensure 100% of material solutions complete required architecture, security, data governance, resiliency, and operational reviews before production approval; track exceptions to an accountable owner and target resolution date.

===========================

* Translate business priorities and operational needs into clear software, Dynamics 365, data, and integration strategies, roadmaps, investment decisions, and executable plans.
* Create clarity around solution ownership, engineering decision rights, service boundaries, data stewardship, integration responsibilities, technical standards, escalation paths, and definitions of done.
* Balance delivery speed with security, reliability, maintainability, user experience, cost, and long-term enterprise architecture.
* Engage business stakeholders early, frame operational problems before selecting solutions, and favor standard Dynamics 365 capabilities where they meet business needs before introducing customization.
* Communicate complex engineering topics in plain business language and provide transparent visibility into delivery, capacity, risk, quality

-----------

The National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) is recruiting an executive leader for the role of Deputy Chief Information Officer (DCIO). The DCIO shapes the future of the Agency's digital infrastructure and information technology that enable America's return to the moon, sustaining presence in orbit around the earth, and advancement of science and discovery.
  
  
\*\* See **Additional Information** for a link to an Informational Session led by NASA's CIO, Sean Gallagher. \*\*

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Senior executives**

Individuals looking for an executive-level job and who meet the five Executive Core Qualifications (ECQs).

  

**Duties**
----------

The Deputy Chief Information Officer:

* Serves as the CIO's principal strategic partner, overseeing daily IT operations and integrating Agency IT programs to ensure capabilities, investments, and risks align with NASA's mission. Shares oversight of over $2B in IT spending and directs a blended workforce of more than 1,500 civil servants and contractors.
* Leads and coordinates across a high-impact team of executives and organizational leaders to implement NASA's integrated IT enterprise, aligning Agency-wide strategy, governance decisions, architectures, and investments to enable exploration, science, and mission support at scale.
* Ensures disciplined stewardship of NASA's IT portfolio, guiding investment lifecycle processes-including approval authority for major initiatives-to deliver secure, technically sound, financially viable solutions in collaboration with Agency financial leadership.
* Leads digital transformation and innovation, advancing emerging technologies through structured pilots, enterprise scaling, and strategic insights that empower NASA's missions in an increasingly complex technological landscape.
* Provides strategic leadership for the talent development and workforce planning of NASA's IT community, ensuring the Agency maintains the technical and leadership capabilities and capacity needed for mission-critical IT services.
* Implements enterprise performance and accountability frameworks, using data-driven metrics to assess IT effectiveness, mission alignment, service quality, risk posture, and compliance.
* Establishes enterprise processes, controls, and performance standards to ensure OCIO programs are efficient, secure, integrated, and consistently meet mission and customer requirements.
* Guides the Agency's Enterprise Architecture (EA) program enabling alignment with mission programs and customer needs and cross-domain integration while ensuring compliance with federal requirements.
* Establishes and manages enterprise customer engagement frameworks, ensuring IT services are responsive, measured through service management practices, feedback mechanisms, and continuous improvement processes.
* Integrates cybersecurity across all IT operations and investments, collaborating with the CISO to ensure enterprise-wide implementation and continuous improvement of security controls.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* The individual selected will be required to file an 'Executive Branch Personnel Financial Disclosure Report' (OGE-278e) within 30 days of appointment and annually from then on.
* Initial Senior Executive Service (SES) Career appointee is subject to a one-year probationary period.
* Successful completion of a background investigation commensurate with the risk and sensitivity level of the position.
* Successful completion of pre-employment and random drug testing may be required.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance as required by the position.
* Must be a U.S. Citizen or National.
* Must meet qualifications requirements by the closing date of this announcement.
* Complete a Declaration for Federal Employment to determine your suitability for Federal employment, at the time requested by the agency.

### **Qualifications**

As a basic requirement for entry into the Senior Executive Service (SES) under a career appointment, you must clearly articulate and describe within your **2-page resume** that you possess the Executive Core Qualifications (ECQs) and Mandatory Technical Qualifications MTQ related to this position**.** If your 2-page resume does not reflect demonstrated evidence of the ECQs and MTQ, you may be disqualified. **Any additional pages over the 2-page limit will not be reviewed.**  
  
Your resume should include evidence of progressively responsible supervisory, managerial, or professional experience which involved management of a program or organization of significant scope and complexity, normally obtained over several years by serving in positions at the GS-15 level or equivalent.
  
  
If you are (1) currently serving under a career SES appointment, (2) eligible for reinstatement into the SES (this means you were previously employed as a Career SES employee and you successfully completed a one-year probationary period), OR (3) have successfully completed a SES Candidate Development Program (CDP) and certified by OPM, you do not need to address the ECQs in your resume. However, your resume must clearly state that you are a current career SES, eligible for SES reinstatement, or SES CDP certified and year of certification.

jobs.title: Director, IT Governance, Risk and Compliance
jobs.description:
At Prologis, we don’t just lead the industry—we define it with a 1.3 billion square foot portfolio and an annual throughput of approximately $3.2 trillion. We create the intelligent infrastructure that powers global commerce, seamlessly connecting the digital and physical worlds. From agile supply chains to energy solutions, our ecosystems help your business move faster, operate smarter and grow sustainably. With unmatched scale, innovation and expertise, Prologis is a category of one—not just shaping the future of logistics but building what comes next.

**Job Title:**

Director, IT Governance, Risk and Compliance

**Company:**

Prologis

**A day in the life**

The Director, IT Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) leads Prologis’ global IT GRC program and team, reporting to the CISO. This role establishes governance, risk, and compliance priorities across the countries where Prologis operates and partners with global business and technology teams to strengthen technology risk and control oversight. The Director works closely with Security, Infrastructure, Internal Audit, Legal, HR, Risk, Finance, and business leadership to address regulatory, audit, third-party, and information risk requirements. The role also modernizes and scales GRC processes through AI, automation, workflow improvements, and system integrations to improve efficiency, reporting, and control effectiveness.

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Lead the global IT GRC program and establish strategy and priorities across governance, technology risk, compliance, and assurance.
* Lead IT risk and controls oversight within the Three Lines Model, including risk assessments, control requirements, risk acceptance and exceptions, control monitoring, remediation oversight, and leadership reporting aligned with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 and applicable regulatory and audit requirements.
* Oversee global technology compliance and assurance activities, including SOX, IT general controls (ITGC), GDPR, DORA, HIPAA, SWIFT, India’s Information Technology Act, and disaster recovery governance and testing oversight
* Govern third-party and cyber supply chain risk, data protection and information risk, investigations, eDiscovery, and technology and cybersecurity support for investor Operational Due Diligence (ODD) assessments and requests.
* Monitor emerging technology risks and evolving regulatory requirements, assess their impact on Prologis, translate applicable changes into GRC and control requirements, and advise leadership on implications.
* Modernize and scale GRC processes by applying AI, workflow automation, and system integrations to improve efficiency, reporting, control monitoring, and control effectiveness.
* Lead and develop the GRC team, manage GRC technology and vendors, and oversee security awareness and IT policy governance, including training campaign planning, communications coordination, and IT policy and procedure governance.

**Building blocks for success**

**Required:**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in IT governance, risk, compliance, IT audit, or related disciplines.
* 3+ years of people-management experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise GRC programs.
* Experience with the NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0 and the Three Lines Model.
* Experience with SOX, IT general controls, and technology-related regulatory requirements in a global environment.
* Experience applying AI, workflow automation, and system integrations to streamline GRC processes, improve reporting, strengthen control monitoring, or increase operational efficiency.
* Ability to influence executives and collaborate effectively across technology, Internal Audit, Legal, HR, Risk, Finance, and other global business functions.
* Ability to exercise sound judgment and discretion when handling sensitive matters.

**Preferred:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience.
* Relevant GRC, audit, risk, or cybersecurity certification.
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt to evolving regulatory and technology requirements in a global environment.
* Demonstrates willingness and capability to leverage emerging technology, automation, and AI tools to improve efficiency, quality, and speed. Exercises sound judgment, creative thinking, and accountability for outcomes.

**Hiring Salary Range of:**

$168,000 - $232,000. Salary and whole compensation package (bonus target & LTI (Long Term Incentives) to be determined by the candidate’s location, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data.

#LI-KR1

**People First**

Each of us working at Prologis plays an essential role in the enduring success of our company. We value people who are decisive, courageous and adaptable. While we are one company, locations and departments operate with autonomy and accountability. **Individuals take the initiative here.**

When you join Prologis, you work shoulder to shoulder with some of the top talent in the industry to do the best work of your career. Every employee belongs. Every employee contributes. **Employees advance their careers here.**

As a successful global enterprise, Prologis has never lost sight of what matters most, our strong belief that our people are the most important part of our business. jobs.description:
As the technical Director of IT Architecture, you will be responsible for leading the overall IT architecture strategy for our dynamic, growing healthcare organization. This individual will be tasked with designing systems that align with business goals, regulatory requirements, and emerging industry technologies. This role manages a talented team of IT Network, Cloud, and Systems Architects, overseeing the design, implementation, and optimization of all enterprise technology solutions. The Director works closely with IT leadership and business stakeholders to drive innovation, improve system interoperability, optimize cost and enhance security across the healthcare organization.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Strategic Leadership & Technology Roadmap:**

* Define and execute a comprehensive IT architecture strategy aligned with business, clinical, and operational goals.
* Lead and manage a team specializing in network, cloud, and systems architecture, ensuring seamless collaboration and efficiency.
* Establish and enforce IT governance, standards, and best practices to ensure compliance with industry regulations (HIPAA, HITECH, HITRUST, etc.).
* Evaluate and integrate emerging technologies (microservices, AI, ML) to improve healthcare delivery and operational efficiency.
* Provide strategic direction for IT infrastructure, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance optimization.
* Strong financial acumen, ensuring positive ROI for Architecture-led initiatives.

**Architectural Leadership & Implementation:**

* Responsible for all aspects of the Network Architecture, ensuring secure, reliable, and high-performance network infrastructure to support healthcare applications and data exchange.
* Responsible for all aspects of the Cloud Architecture initiatives, including hybrid and multi-cloud strategies, ensuring compliance, cost optimization, and interoperability with on-premises systems.
* Guide Systems Architecture development, ensuring robust design, security, and integration of core business and healthcare applications, including EHR/EMR (Epic).

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:**

* Act as the primary liaison between IT architecture teams and IT leadership, translating business needs into technology strategies.
* Partner with IT Security team to develop and enforce security frameworks that protect patient data and mitigate cybersecurity threats.
* Partner with Cloud team to establish common tooling and automation (e.g., CloudFormation, AWS CDK, AWS Landing Zone Accelerator, Terraform, Kubernetes, Docker, Jenkins).
* Work closely with software vendors, system integrators, and cloud service providers to optimize technology investments.
* Foster collaboration across cross-functional IT teams, ensuring alignment with infrastructure, security, and application teams.

**Performance Management & Risk Mitigation:**

* Establish KPIs and performance metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of IT architecture initiatives.
* Identify and mitigate risks related to network vulnerabilities, cloud security, and system failures.
* Optimize IT spending by implementing cost-effective solutions.
* Continuously assess system performance and scalability to meet the growing demands of healthcare operations.

**REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field.
* 10+ years of progressive experience in IT architecture, including at least 5 years in a leadership role managing network, cloud, and systems architecture teams preferably within a healthcare organization.
* Network Architecture: Strong experience with SD-WAN, VPNs, firewalls, network security protocols, and healthcare data exchange networks.
* Cloud Architecture: Strong experience with AWS, Well-Architected Framework, and hybrid cloud solutioning.
* Demonstrated history of assessing, testing, implementing modern platform visibility solutions (DataDog, Dynatrace, New Relic, Prometheus / Grafana).

**PREFERRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Master's degree preferred.

**CERTIFICATES, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS PREFERRED:**

* Recent certifications in relevant cloud platforms (AWS Certified: Solutions Architect Professional, AWS Security Specialty, etc Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect, etc.).
CISSP, CCNP, HITRUST, or FinOps Certification.  

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES (KSAs):**

* Systems Architecture: Expertise in the M365 suite, server infrastructure, virtualization, storage solutions, disaster recovery, and healthcare IT standards (HL7, FHIR, DICOM, etc.).

* Strong leadership and team management skills. You are a thought-leader and a mentor.

**The Opportunity**
===================

**Ascension Property Services** is a fast-growing, acquisition-built platform of skilled-trades operating companies spanning electrical, mechanical, plumbing, and property services. The platform currently comprises roughly 20 operating companies and approximately 1,500 employees across multiple offices and field locations and continues to grow through acquisition. Day-to-day IT services are delivered by the Company's managed services provider (MSP).

The **Director of Information Technology** is the Company's internal IT leader, reporting to the Chief Financial Officer. The role owns the technology function for the platform: managing the MSP relationship and holding it to its service levels; integrating newly acquired and legacy operating companies onto the Company's standard IT platform; and owning the cybersecurity program that protects the enterprise from phishing, business email compromise, and payment fraud. This is a high-visibility position within the Office of the CFO, with regular exposure to executive leadership, the private-equity sponsor's deal team, and lenders.

**Position Summary**
====================

* Serve as the Company's internal owner of information technology: set IT strategy, standards, budget, and priorities across the platform.
* Manage the MSP relationship: govern service levels (SLAs), performance, and cost, and hold the provider accountable for reliable, high-quality service to the Company and all operating companies.
* Integrate new and legacy operating companies onto the Company's standard IT platform, systems, and controls.
* Own cybersecurity and risk: establish the controls and safety net that protect the business from phishing, social engineering, and payment/wire fraud.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* **Managed Services Provider (MSP) Management and Service Delivery**

* Own the relationship with the Company's managed services provider (MSP) as the internal executive accountable for IT service delivery across all operating companies.
* Define, govern, and enforce service levels (SLAs), response and resolution targets, escalation paths, and performance reporting; hold the MSP accountable to the contracted standards.
* Review and approve the MSP scope, service catalog, and pricing; manage the contract, renewals, and change orders; ensure the Company receives the service it is paying for.
* Run regular service reviews with the MSP; monitor ticket volumes, uptime, response times, and end-user satisfaction; and report performance to leadership.
* Serve as the escalation point for major incidents and service failures; drive root-cause resolution and corrective-action plans.
* Ensure MSP delivery is standardized and consistent across all sites and newly acquired operating companies.

* **Operating-Company Onboarding and Platform Integration (M&A)**

* Own IT integration for newly acquired operating companies: current-state assessment, cutover planning, and migration onto the Company's standard platform (identity, email, network, endpoints, and business systems), directing the MSP as the delivery resource.
* Develop a repeatable IT integration playbook with Day-1 / Day-30 / Day-90 checklists to accelerate onboarding and reduce integration risk.
* Consolidate and standardize disparate legacy domains, email tenants, applications, and toolsets onto common platforms; retire redundant infrastructure and licenses.
* Standardize identity and access management (single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, role-based access) across every operating company.
* Partner with corporate development, finance, and operating-company leadership on IT diligence input, integration timelines, and transition-services-agreement (TSA) exit.

* **Cybersecurity, Risk, and Fraud Prevention**

* Own the enterprise cybersecurity program and ensure appropriate, consistent controls across all operating companies, whether delivered internally or through the MSP.
* Direct email security and anti-phishing controls; run continuous phishing simulations and mandatory security-awareness training for all employees.
* **Prevent payment fraud:** implement controls against business email compromise (BEC), wire / ACH fraud, and vendor or banking-detail change fraud, working with finance and accounts payable on verification, call-back, and dual-control procedures.
* Ensure endpoint detection and response (EDR), multi-factor authentication, patch management, least-privilege access, and secure backup and disaster recovery are in place, and validate that the MSP is delivering them.
* Establish incident-response and business-continuity plans; run tabletop exercises; define breach escalation and notification protocols.
* Align the program to a recognized framework (for example, NIST CSF or CIS Controls); manage cyber-insurance requirements, vendor risk (including the MSP's own security posture), and periodic security assessments.
* Provide clear, periodic risk and posture reporting to the CFO, executive leadership, the sponsor deal team, and the Board.

* **Infrastructure, Networks, and End-User Computing**

* Oversee, through the MSP, the network, connectivity, cloud, and telephony across headquarters, branch offices, and distributed field / job-site locations.
* Ensure reliable management of the endpoint and mobile-device fleet and field technology, and dependable connectivity for a mobile, field-based workforce.
* Ensure backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity for business-critical systems.

* **Applications, Data, and Business Systems**

* Support and rationalize core business applications (accounting, project management, payroll / HRIS, service dispatch, and estimating).
* Partner with finance and operations on system consolidation, reporting, and data integrity across operating companies.
* Support the data-governance and reporting needs of the Office of the CFO.

Bodwé is the Professional Services Group of Mno-Bmadsen, the investment enterprise and a wholly owned instrumentality of the Pokagon Band of Potawatomi. By integrating expertise across architecture, engineering, construction, and facility management, we deliver holistic, end-to-end solutions that drive efficiency and deliver distinctive outcomes.

**Position Summary**

The Vice President of Technology & Innovation leads how Bodwé uses technology to improve the way we pursue, plan, manage, and deliver work. This leader identifies, evaluates, implements, and scales technologies that improve quality, efficiency, collaboration, decision-making, and client outcomes across the organization.

### **Responsibilities**

* Lead technical program management (TPM) team and oversee critical initiatives with major cross-functional dependencies
* Expedite decision-making by distilling complex issues into clear, actionable choices for leadership, bring structure to complex programs, operationalize big ideas, and navigate roadblocks to deliver results

**Ascension Property Services** is a fast-growing, acquisition-built platform of skilled-trades operating companies spanning electrical, mechanical, plumbing, and property services.
